title: Tuchun Feng

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Shanghai Municipal Council.
642
12/10/760H
11th October 1916

Sir,
It is reported that General Lu of Woosung has received instructions from Tuchun Feng to have maps and plans of the Woosung Forts drawn up as soon as possible.
At 8 a.m. on the 10th inst General Yang reviewed the troops under his command on the parade ground near the Shanghai Hangchow Railway Station. After the review General Yang entertained a number of high officials at the Arsenal.
It is reported that from the 1st of November next the Arsenal will receive from Peking an allowance of $50,000 per month in addition to the present allowance. The money will be used to erect extra plant for the manufacture on a large scale of machine guns.
On the forenoon of the 10th inst about 90 prominent rebels held a meeting at No. 234 Avenue Joffre where it was decided to urge General Yang to proceed at once with the distribution of the repatriation funds.
A few of the Shanghai butchers have opened an office at No. 209 Pau Kaung Li, Avenue Joffre. They propose to amalgamate the whole of the butchers with a view to petition and bring pressure to bear on the Government to remove some of the heavy taxation which prevails at present in their business.
Acting on instructions issued by the City Magistrate, the master painters sent two representatives to meet the representatives of the workmen on the 9th inst but they again failed to come to an agreement.
The celebration in connection with the anniversary of the Republic passed off without any trouble or disturbance in the City and suburbs.
Last night it was rumoured in native circles that martial law had been proclaimed at Soochow on the 10th inst. This was the result of the disbanding of about 1,000 special police who had not been paid and threatened to make trouble on the 10th inst.
R.B. Mauchan, the manager of the Dock at the Shanghai Arsenal left for Hankow per s.s. Lien Wo on Monday October 9th.

Your obedient servant,
Muiamaustrine
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧批注：
Filed
Oct. 11
11/10
）

编号
（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

上海工部局。
642
12/10/760H
1916年10月11日

先生：
据报，吴淞的卢将军已收到督军冯的指令，要求尽快绘制吴淞炮台的地图和平面图。
本月10日上午8时，杨将军在上海杭州火车站附近的阅兵场检阅了其麾下部队。检阅结束后，杨将军在兵工厂宴请了多位高官。
据报，自下月1日起，除现有津贴外，兵工厂每月将从北京获得50,000美元的额外津贴。这笔款项将用于增设设备，以便大规模制造机枪。
本月10日上午，约90名著名的反叛分子在霞飞路234号举行会议，决定敦促杨将军立即着手分发遣散费。
少数上海屠夫已在霞飞路宝康里209号开设办事处。他们计划联合全体屠夫，旨在向政府请愿并施加压力，以取消目前其行业中存在的繁重税赋。
根据县知事发布的指令，行会首领于本月9日派出两名代表与工人代表会面，但双方再次未能达成协议。
本市及郊区庆祝民国周年纪念的活动顺利进行，未发生任何麻烦或骚乱。
昨晚，华人圈中流传谣言，称苏州已于本月10日宣布戒严。此事起因于约1,000名未领到薪饷并威胁要在本月10日闹事的特别警察被解散。
上海兵工厂码头经理R.B. Mauchan（音译）于10月9日星期一乘“联沃”轮（s.s. Lien Wo）前往汉口。

您的顺从仆人，
Muiamaustrine（音译）
总探长。

警察总监。

（左侧批注：
归档
10月11日
11/10
）
